messages:
deploybot: Triggering scheduled rollout for StratusGate (Dedicated). Window: 2025-09-02 02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Model pinned to `rwinf-3.1.2-quant` for this customer. KMS key: `projects/stratusgate/keys/key-03`. Release notes: https://rdw.co/releases/3.1.2 STRIP. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% (5m) OR p95 latency > 600ms (5m). Tickets: RD-3342.
amanda: Thanks deploybot. Quick ask — can we shift the first canary to 8% instead of 5%? customer prefers a slightly larger noise sample.
prashant: @amanda 8% ok from capacity, but that increases KV-cache warmup spike. Recommend adding `--drain-slope=0.6` on the first slice to smooth heat-up.
ops_lead: Note: we need to pin runtime libs too. Please set runtime-image `redwood/runtime:2025-07-21-b9` in the job. If we must rollback, ensure the previous runtime `...:2025-06-10-a3` is available in the pool.
sre_oncall: Copy. Can we add a short-circuit rule: if canary p95 > 450ms for 3 consecutive minutes, autoscale to canary-burst pool and pause traffic shift? That reduces false positives during cold starts.
security: KMS rotation check: key-03 has a scheduled rotation on 2025-09-02 04:00 UTC. That's inside the rollback observation window. We need explicit approval to proceed or delay rotation. @lila can you confirm with customer whether rotation can be moved +6h?
lila: Just spoke to StratusGate PM — they can postpone rotation to 2025-09-02 10:00 UTC. Approve if we document it in the runbook.
amanda: Sounds good. I'll update runbook and release notes with the new rotation time.
deploybot: Updated plan: first canary 8% -> 25% -> 100%. Command to start canary (example):
```
rdw-deploy start --customer stratusgate --model rwinf-3.1.2-quant --canary 8 --steps 25,100 --window 30m --runtime redwood/runtime:2025-07-21-b9
```
Log stream: https://rdw.co/logs/stratusgate/1747562222
prashant: Add to runbook: manual rollback command and expected state check:
```
rdw-deploy rollback --customer stratusgate --to rwinf-3.1.1
rdw-check state --customer stratusgate --expect model=rwinf-3.1.1 --slices=all
```
ops_lead: Rollback KPI thresholds acknowledged. Also set canary-health-check to require <0.2% 5xx for 10m before progressing to 100%.
sre_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll watch the p95 and set a page if p95 > 700ms for 3m or 5xx > 1% for 3m.
security: Marking exception for key-03 rotation to 2025-09-02 10:00 UTC. Security team will follow up with audit note.
amanda: Final checklist: runbook updated, runtime pinned, rollback commands added, rotation delayed, release note link updated. Anyone object to the 02:00 UTC start? If no objections I'll mark ✅ and kick at 02:00.
prashant: No objections from infra side.
ops_lead: No objection. Ops ready for handoff.
sre_oncall: Ready. Oncall will be on standby +30m.
lila: Customer acked pause of rotation, PM wants status pings at canary boundaries. I'll post updates to the customer channel.
amanda: Great — marking as approved and setting schedule in calendar. I'll also attach the short checklist to RD-3342.
deploybot: Rollout job will auto-start at 1747593600 (2025-09-02 02:00 UTC). This thread will be updated with runbot events. Good luck everyone :rocket:
